children: Taiwan's central bank kept its benchmark interest rate on hold on Thursday, as expected, given the strong performance of the tech-focused economy and relatively mild inflation.
The central bank's decision to leave the benchmark discount rate (TWINTR=ECI) at 2% aligned with forecasts in a Reuters poll, where 28 of 31 economists projected no change in monetary policy.
